questions.question: What did many Impressionist painters investigate through repeated outdoor studies?
choices: How changing light and atmosphere affect color and appearance
How to paint only historical myths
How to replace painting with sculpture

questions.question: Which feature is often associated with Impressionist painting?
choices: Uniform outlines and smooth finish only
Visible brushwork and attention to fleeting light

questions.question: Why did some Impressionists paint outdoors?
choices: To avoid looking at the subject
To observe and record changing conditions directly

questions.question: Which subject was common in Impressionist art?
How did photography influence some 19th-century painters?
choices: It encouraged experimentation with viewpoint, framing, and the captured moment
It prevented artists from depicting people
It required all paintings to be black and white

questions.question: Which artist is strongly associated with repeated studies of haystacks and water lilies?
What distinguishes many Post-Impressionist approaches from Impressionism?
choices: They all returned to medieval gold backgrounds
Artists used color, form, or structure in more individually directed ways

questions.question: Which Post-Impressionist artist explored bold color and expressive brushwork in works such as Starry Night?
Paul Cézanne is often noted for exploring
choices: underlying geometric structure in forms and landscapes
single-point perspective as the only valid method

questions.question: Georges Seurat developed a technique using
choices: small dots of color placed to blend optically

questions.question: A painting uses separate brushstrokes of blue and yellow that appear green from a distance. What is the viewer experiencing?
Why might an Impressionist scene seem cropped or off-center?
choices: The artist necessarily ran out of canvas
All Impressionist art used the same template
The composition can suggest a spontaneous modern viewpoint

questions.question: Which statement best describes the relation between Impressionism and Post-Impressionism?
choices: Post-Impressionist artists responded to Impressionist innovations while pursuing varied directions
Post-Impressionism was a single style that rejected color
The movements are unrelated to 19th-century painting

questions.question: A painter emphasizes color shapes more than accurate detail. Which approach may be relevant?
choices: A Post-Impressionist exploration of color and structure

questions.question: What does plein-air painting mean?
Degas is especially known for paintings and drawings of
choices: dancers and scenes of modern life

questions.question: Why is it inaccurate to describe all Impressionist paintings as simply 'blurry'?
choices: Their brushwork served varied ways of depicting light, color, movement, and perception

questions.question: A work by Cézanne simplifies a mountain into blocks and planes. What may this reveal?
choices: A strict commitment to photographic detail
An interest in organizing observed forms through structure
A return to medieval manuscript illumination

questions.question: What can comparing an artist's repeated views of one subject reveal?
choices: How light, weather, time, and artistic choices change the image
That the works must be identical

questions.question: When analyzing a Post-Impressionist painting, what is a useful starting point?
choices: Guess the artist's mood without evidence
Assume all viewers respond the same way
Describe how color, brushwork, and form contribute to the work's effect
